$comment: Canonical list of the host functions plc-st-test exposes to Structured Text. The TwinCAT and Automation Studio PlcStTest libraries declare exactly these functions; the core conformance test (packages/core/test/vendorlib.test.ts) keeps this file and the registered host functions in step. IEC standard library functions (CONCAT, SHL, TON, ...) are vendor built-ins and are not listed.

functions.name: ASSERT_TRUE
functions.description: Fails the test when the condition is FALSE.

functions.name: ASSERT_FALSE
functions.description: Fails the test when the condition is TRUE.

functions.name: ASSERT_EQUAL
functions.description: Fails the test when actual and expected differ in type or value.

vendorNotes.twincat: Declare the parameters as ANY and read them through the typed ANY accessors; the typed variants (ASSERT_EQUAL_<TYPE>) are also provided for call sites that want a compile-time type check.
vendorNotes.br: Automation Studio has no ANY: provide one overload-style function per typed variant (ASSERT_EQUAL_<TYPE>) and use the typed variants in tests.

functions.name: ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL
functions.description: Fails the test when actual and expected are equal.

vendorNotes.twincat: Declare the parameters as ANY and read them through the typed ANY accessors; the typed variants (ASSERT_EQUAL_<TYPE>) are also provided for call sites that want a compile-time type check.
vendorNotes.br: Automation Studio has no ANY: provide one overload-style function per typed variant (ASSERT_EQUAL_<TYPE>) and use the typed variants in tests.

functions.name: ASSERT_NEAR
functions.description: Fails the test when |actual - expected| exceeds the tolerance.

vendorNotes.twincat: Declare the parameters as LREAL; REAL arguments widen implicitly.
vendorNotes.br: Declare the parameters as LREAL; REAL arguments widen implicitly.

functions.name: ASSERT_ARRAY_EQUAL
functions.description: Fails the test when two arrays differ in bounds or at any element.

vendorNotes.twincat: Declare the parameters as ANY; the host compares bounds and elements.
vendorNotes.br: No variable-length array parameter exists; provide per-element-type overloads or a pointer + length variant.

functions.description: Typed ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL: fails when either argument does not fit BOOL or the values are equal.

functions.name: RUN_CYCLES
functions.description: Runs n scan cycles of the suite under test.

functions.name: RUN_UNTIL
functions.description: Runs cycles until the ST expression is TRUE; returns the number of cycles run and fails after maxCycles.

functions.name: MOCK
functions.description: Replaces the function block instance at the path with a mock that records calls and skips its body.

functions.name: MOCK_RETURNS
functions.description: Sets the value a mocked instance output (path ends with the output name) returns after each call.

vendorNotes.twincat: Declare the parameters as ANY and read them through the typed ANY accessors; the typed variants (ASSERT_EQUAL_<TYPE>) are also provided for call sites that want a compile-time type check.
vendorNotes.br: Automation Studio has no ANY: provide one overload-style function per typed variant (ASSERT_EQUAL_<TYPE>) and use the typed variants in tests.

functions.name: EXPECT_CALLS
functions.description: Fails unless the mocked instance was called exactly count times.

functions.name: EXPECT_CALLED_WITH
functions.description: Fails unless some recorded call of the mocked instance had the named input equal to value.

vendorNotes.twincat: Declare the parameters as ANY and read them through the typed ANY accessors; the typed variants (ASSERT_EQUAL_<TYPE>) are also provided for call sites that want a compile-time type check.
vendorNotes.br: Automation Studio has no ANY: provide one overload-style function per typed variant (ASSERT_EQUAL_<TYPE>) and use the typed variants in tests.

functions.name: EXPECT_NOT_CALLED
functions.description: Fails when the mocked instance was called at all.

functions.name: FOR_EACH_ROW
functions.description: Reruns the rest of the test once per row of a suite-level array of structs, each row on a fresh suite instance.

functions.name: ROW
functions.description: Returns a copy of the current row of the FOR_EACH_ROW table.

vendorNotes.twincat: The return type depends on the table; declare it as ANY or generate one accessor per row struct type.
vendorNotes.br: No ANY return type exists; use a per-struct accessor or read the table directly.
